acquisition_tiers.scientific_purpose: Unlock full 102-channel SED reconstruction for Pointing 0003 independent test set, enabling detection of 3.05um H2O ice, 4.26um CO2 ice, and PAH bands.
acquisition_tiers.necessity_justification: Without D2-D6 science exposures, SPECTRA v2 operates with 90-99% channel masking and cannot perform physical spectrophotometric SED classification.

acquisition_tiers.tier: Tier 2: High Priority (Pointing 0003 Gaia DR3 Local Cone Search)
acquisition_tiers.scientific_purpose: Provide localized high-density astrometric reference stars to eliminate stellar false alarms and establish static controls for Pointing 0003.
acquisition_tiers.sky_region: Cone centered at RA=165.685 deg, Dec=-69.565 deg, radius=2.5 deg
observation_ids: Gaia DR3 ICRS J2016.0 cone search
detector_coverage: G-band astrometry, pmRA, pmDec, parallax, ruwe
acquisition_tiers.dependencies: Heidelberg TAP or ESA Gaia archive
acquisition_tiers.necessity_justification: Current all-sky 5000-star downsample has zero stars within 300 arcseconds of Pointing 0003.

acquisition_tiers.tier: Tier 3: Medium Priority (Multi-Month Seasonal Repeat Pointings)
acquisition_tiers.scientific_purpose: Provide genuine weeks-to-months baseline for supernova, TDE, and long-period variable star detection in CHRONOS-X.
acquisition_tiers.sky_region: Survey pass repeat covering identical ecliptic coordinates 6 months later
observation_ids: SPHEREx survey pass 2 / seasonal repeat planning period
acquisition_tiers.dependencies: Availability of repeat survey pass in IRSA archive
acquisition_tiers.necessity_justification: Intra-pointing dithers (dt=6.45 min) only detect fast moving objects; seasonal repeat observations are mandatory for astrophysical transient discovery.

acquisition_tiers.tier: Tier 4: Benchmark Priority (NASA Challenge Target Pointings)
acquisition_tiers.scientific_purpose: Ingest Level-2 science files covering the 5 NASA Challenge targets (Barnard's Star, eps Ind B, WISE 0855, RW Aurigae, R Draconis) once public SPHEREx survey releases cover their coordinates.
acquisition_tiers.remote_source: NASA IRSA SPHEREx public archive (future releases)
acquisition_tiers.necessity_justification: Target demonstration for NASA challenge benchmarking.
